summary: A Navigraph-style flight card, a Flight tab for your OFP, airport info on the map and a more professional map style.
releaseNotes: The phone has a Flight tab that opens your OFP: departure and arrival side by side, the route, when it was imported, and the key figures.
Click an airport on the map to see its info, weather and charts.
The map has an EFB look: a thin route with the active leg in cyan, small waypoint triangles, airport symbols showing their runway, a 2-minute track line and fewer traffic labels.
Phone tabs open their page directly, without the lock screen.
The OFP shows at once instead of waiting for the weather.
The OFP page no longer tags every value with OFP.
